explication: Pocket ID is a self-hosted, passkey-only OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 provider. The principal workflow is: an OIDC client redirects a user to Pocket ID; HTTP routing and OIDC authorization create or resume interaction state; passkey authentication and consent authorize the request; token services issue OIDC artifacts back to the client. The system also provides administrative user/client management, provisioning integrations, audit logs, email verification, and configurable file/database storage. Several peripheral implementations are represented only at directory level because their source was not sampled.
